name: John H. Kerr Reservoir
species: all species in season under Virginia DWR regulations
method: open during state seasons; Virginia hunting license only, no Corps permit found
dates: Virginia statewide/county seasons. Kerr is not in DWR's public-lands firearms deer table, so private-land seasons for Mecklenburg, Halifax and Charlotte counties apply (the same as the app's army_corps 'private-rules' policy).
notes: USACE: 'All project lands are open to hunting with appropriate state license, except developed recreation areas, or unless otherwise posted.' DWR: about 40,000 acres open to hunting within about 55,000 acres of Corps land around the lake (both states); 26 wildlife management units. The polygon (45,514 ac in Virginia) is all Corps fee land in DCR's layer plus DWR's WMU polygons, minus 19 developed recreation areas (1,252 ac) taken from the USACE Recreation Areas layer and kept in kerr-recreation-areas.geojson: Corps campgrounds (North Bend, Ivy Hill, Longwood, Rudds Creek, Island Creek, Palmer Point, Buffalo Park), day-use areas (Staunton View, Tailrace, Liberty Hill, Buffalo Springs), boat ramps (Eastland Creek, Eagle Point, Bluestone, Clover), the Visitor Assistance and Tanner centers, and Clarksville and Willow Grove (Rudds Creek) marinas. USACE labels Buffalo Park's polygon 'Wildlife Areas (Gated)' but it holds the park's ramp and campground at Carters Point. USACE's Willow Grove polygon (212 ac on Corps land) is labelled 'Willow Grove Marina (Rochichi Wildlife Management Area)' and may include huntable woods; it is cut whole. USACE's park polygons for Staunton View, Island Creek, Liberty Hill and Clover overlap DWR's Hogan Creek, Island Creek, Liberty Hill and Clover WMU polygons; the USACE boundary wins. Not mapped (no boundary found): the group camps on Corps land (Camp Jean Short, Presbyterian Point), Hyco and Buffalo Access ramps, and the picnic area beside the dam outside Tailrace Park. Occoneechee and Staunton River state parks (on Corps land) and Corps flowage easements are cut out. Corps land along the Dan and Staunton arms includes the river channels. The 66-ac overlap with DCR's 'Buggs Island Lake' water polygon is removed. Virginia Visitor Assistance Center 434-738-6143.
sources: https://www.saw.usace.army.mil/Locations/District-Lakes-and-Dams/John-H-Kerr-1/Recreation/Hunting/ (live site returns 403; text read from the Wayback copy of 2024-11-28)
